loopback_caveat: Startup and TTFR are measured against a loopback endpoint; transport_mode=loopback-h1 is mandatory. The first-request latency component (TTFR) includes only loopback network cost, not real network path.

what_it_measures.startup_ms: Process-spawn (t0, harness-owned) -> first HTTP 200 from the health endpoint. Black-box cold start.
what_it_measures.ttfr_ms: First health 200 (ready) -> first HTTP 2xx from the business endpoint. The first-call penalty: lazy init, cold JIT, connection-pool fill, class loading.
what_it_measures.spawn_to_first_request_ms: t0 -> first business 2xx. Startup + TTFR end to end.

method.t0_definition: Monotonic timestamp captured by the runner immediately before it invokes the target's EXTERNAL_START_CMD (the launch contract backgrounds the JVM and writes its PID). t0 therefore includes shell fork + JVM exec, identically across all targets.
method.iterations_rationale: Cold start has high run-to-run variance; a single launch is not publishable. Report median + p90/p99 over independent JVM launches.
method.ttfr_poll: Tight back-to-back attempts with no sleep once ready; the first 2xx defines TTFR (= the latency of the first business call).
method.between_iterations: Each launch is stopped via EXTERNAL_STOP_CMD and the port is confirmed free before the next spawn, so every iteration is a genuine cold process.

preconditions.database: The target's database and any backend dependencies (Postgres/Neo4j) MUST already be running. This scenario measures application cold start only — it does not start or time the DB. A cold DB would contaminate startup_ms with DB warmup.
preconditions.build: The target jar must already be built; build time is out of scope.

fairness_caveats: 'ready' semantics differ per framework (Spring 'Started', Quarkus 'started', Exeris banner, native-image). startup_ms is a uniform black-box spawn->health metric; cross-runtime rows must state this and must NOT be collapsed without the caveat.
artifact_kind matters: a native-image target starts in a fundamentally different regime than a JIT JVM. Never frame native vs JIT cold start as apples-to-apples without the artifact_kind label.
JVM flags (AppCDS, tiered-compilation stop level, -Xss, AlwaysPreTouch) materially move startup_ms; they are part of the launch contract and are captured in env.json.
This is an exploratory descriptive measurement, not a guard/regression gate.
